name: Shepherd's Pie
description: A classic shepherd's pie made with ground beef, mixed vegetables, and topped with mashed potatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef in an electric skillet. Drain excess fat.
Add onion soup mix, frozen vegetables, beef cube, salt, and pepper. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes.
Pour the mixture into a 6-cup (1.5 L) casserole dish or square baking dish.
Top with mashed potatoes and sprinkle with paprika if desired.
Bake at 400°F for 15 to 20 minutes, until the potatoes are firm and golden brown.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

keywords: shepherd's pie, ground beef, mashed potatoes, casserole

_similar.name: English Shepherd's Pie
_similar.description: A traditional shepherd's pie with ground beef, vegetables, and mashed potatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef briskly over high heat. Drain off excess fat.
Add the chopped onion and reduce heat. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until the meat is well browned.
Sprinkle the flour over the meat mixture and stir to coat evenly.
Gradually add water, stock cube, Worcestershire sauce, salt, pepper, bay leaf, and thyme. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Add the can of peas to the meat mixture.
Transfer the meat mixture to a casserole dish and cover with mashed potatoes.
Bake in a 400°F oven until the top is golden brown.

_similar.keywords: shepherd's pie, ground beef, mashed potatoes

_similar.name: Beef & Barley Soup
_similar.description: A hearty beef and barley soup with vegetables and tomato, ideal for freezing and reheating.
recipeIngredient: 3 cups cooked roast beef (or 2-3 cups chopped hamburg meat)
½ cup pearl or pot barley

recipeInstructions.text: Heat water and bouillon cubes in a large pot, stirring until dissolved.
Add remaining ingredients except beef and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 1½ hours.
Add beef and simmer for an additional ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef barley soup, hearty soup, freezer-friendly

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: Traditional cabbage rolls filled with a savory mixture of ground pork, beef, and rice, simmered in tomato juice.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil the cabbage head for 10 minutes to soften the leaves. Drain and let cool.
Chop the onion and fry in lard for 10 minutes until softened.
Mix the cooked onion and lard with ground pork, ground beef, rice, salt, and pepper until well combined.
Peel off cabbage leaves and cut out the thick stem. Place about 1 tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each leaf, fold the sides, and roll into a neat package.
Line the bottom of a large pot with a layer of cabbage leaves to prevent burning.
Arrange the cabbage rolls seam-side down in the pot, layering them as needed.
Pour the tomato juice over the cabbage rolls, ensuring they are mostly covered.
Bring the tomato juice to a simmer, then reduce heat and let cook for the entire afternoon (approximately 3 hours).

_similar.keywords: cabbage rolls, stuffed cabbage, ground meat, comfort food

_similar.name: Hamburger Pie
_similar.description: A savory pie made with ground beef, green beans, and tomato soup, topped with a layer of mashed potatoes and baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat 4 Tbsp oil in a pan and brown the sliced onion.
Add the hamburger, salt, and pepper to the pan and brown the meat.
Add the cooked green beans and tomato soup to the meat mixture and mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with warm milk and beaten egg.
Spoon the mashed potatoes in mounds over the top of the meat mixture in the casserole.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
